# NASA Astrobiology

> > NASA's astrobiology program exploring the origins, evolution, and distribution of life in the universe through missions like Mars 2020 Perseverance, OSIRIS-REx, and research on biosignatures.

This site covers NASA's astrobiology research including Mars exploration, asteroid sample return missions, exoplanet studies, and the search for life beyond Earth. It also hosts educational resources and archives from the former NASA Astrobiology Institute (NAI).

## Key Topics

- Astrobiology
- Biosignatures
- Mars 2020 Perseverance
- OSIRIS-REx
- Life detection
- Exoplanets
- Mars exploration
- Origins of life
- Europa and Titan
- Planetary science
- Asteroid samples
- NASA Astrobiology Institute (NAI)
- AbSciCon
- Solar System exploration
- Space science education

## Overview

- [Homepage | Astrobiology](https://astrobiology.nasa.gov): NASA astrobiology homepage featuring Mars 2020 Perseverance & OSIRIS-REx

## Educational Resources

- [Graphic Novels | Astrobiology](https://astrobiology.nasa.gov/resources/graphic-histories): Educational graphic novel series on astrobiology & biosignatures search
